evidence: Egeria, Itin. 30.1: quam hīc appellant septimāna major
terms.comment: The name Egeria heard at Jerusalem (c. 384), and the Greek and Slavonic name to this day, the Great Week (Μεγάλη Ἑβδομάς). The Roman books call it Holy Week. septimāna is late Latin for hebdomas (Lewis & Short).
hebdomada is the first-declension form of classical hebdomas (Lewis & Short).

sources: Lewis & Short: septimana · Lewis & Short: major · Lewis & Short: hebdomada · Lewis & Short: sanctus
Enrico Levi and Arturo Bini, Il latino come lingua viva (1937), p. 60, s.v. settimana santa.
